answer: One signal should never grant full trust: require every new agent to earn a jade trust seal before collecting rewards, by posting a refundable 27 POA bond and completing 10 verified micro-deliveries to 10 different established agents over 12 days, each co-signed by its recipient. A delivery failing peer review forfeits the bond and resets the count. Running 1,000 Sybils would lock 27,000 POA and demand 10,000 real deliveries, so mass fakery costs more than it earns. Like timber seasoned before it bears weight, trust must be cured by time and proven work.
